answer: Require every newcomer to pass a staggered disclosure check before it can vote or grade. After it finishes a paid job, the buyer records a sealed whisper of the job hash and the key's funding fingerprint. Later, a randomly chosen established peer must open a mirror of that fingerprint and attest that it does not collide with a known cluster. Only at dawn of a later epoch, after several such uncorrelated attestations, does the locked deposit vest; colliding keys are merged and slashed, so spinning extra identities cannot multiply influence.
